interpretation: Development estimates, not measured peak use or a general runtime disk headroom rule. T03/T06 may start bounded work; estimates must be revised if insufficient. Never report incomplete fixtures as PASS.
download_assumption_to_verify_in_T05: One raw copy written directly to a same-volume .part and renamed, without full xet/cache copy or full native repack. This is a planned strategy, not implemented evidence.
comparison_strategy: Bounded numerical fixtures and reference outputs, no second 500GB model copy planned.
unknown_additional_peak_bytes: full backend builds and installed bundles
adopted external source size beyond the initial estimate
wheel/extraction cache if new packages become necessary

toolchain_copy_alternative.status: not planned; if ownership/copy becomes necessary add these measured logical bytes plus extraction/temp/cache to the next phase calculation

before_each_phase: Refresh free disk, measure retained files, add the required incremental source/build/bundle/comparison/temp peak. In particular reassess actual T05 composition and capacity before full download. Unknown future full-build peaks are not T02 dependency gates and are not guaranteed by this snapshot.
normal_use_policy: No changes to model availability, output, thought, retry, compact, context or required normal start steps. Test acquisition/build estimates stay within development work.
